_comment: Curated expression catalog - the ONLY render/cache key axis for facial expression / mood. Grows only via the candidate approval flow in the Poses admin tab.

neutral.prompt: calm neutral face, relaxed brow, soft mouth, attentive eyes

positive.prompt: warm genuine smile, bright eyes, raised cheeks, relaxed brow

sad.prompt: downcast eyes, slightly drawn mouth corners, low gaze, subdued posture of the face

angry.prompt: tense jaw, narrowed eyes, drawn eyebrows, firm pressed lips

nervous.prompt: uneasy darting eyes, slightly raised brows, tense mouth, guarded look

tired.prompt: heavy eyelids, soft unfocused gaze, slack facial muscles

aroused.prompt: half-lidded eyes, parted lips, flushed cheeks, intent gaze

surprised.prompt: wide open eyes, raised eyebrows, slightly open mouth

animal_neutral.label: Neutral
animal_neutral.prompt: natural calm animal expression, relaxed ears and muscles, steady gaze

animal_attentive.label: Attentive
animal_attentive.prompt: alert attentive animal expression, ears oriented toward interest, focused gaze

animal_relaxed.label: Relaxed
animal_relaxed.prompt: relaxed content animal expression, soft gaze, loose muscles, ears at ease

animal_defensive.label: Defensive
animal_defensive.prompt: defensive wary animal expression, tense muscles, guarded gaze, ears drawn back naturally

humanoid.label: Humanoid
humanoid.pose_prompt: standing naturally upright, arms resting at the sides, full body visible

animal.label: Animal
animal.pose_prompt: standing naturally in a relaxed neutral stance appropriate to the animal's anatomy, full body visible
